title: The Hawthorne Effect in Reasoning Models: Evaluating and Steering Test Awareness
reasoning: The paper investigates the impact of test awareness on LLM safety alignment, specifically looking at how models handle harmful and unethical requests (such as creating phishing emails, disinformation, or fake witness statements). It uses benchmarks like HarmBench and evaluates the model's adherence to ethical guidelines when it perceives it is being tested versus when it is in a 'real' scenario.
